message.content: I'm ending my turn without trading. I only have $26, but Gemini owns no complete colour set, so any rent I land on is small. If I get hit with a tax or a repairs card, I can still raise cash then by mortgaging my four unmortgaged properties or selling houses. I didn't offer Atlantic Avenue for cash, because Gemini owns Ventnor and Marvin Gardens and Atlantic would give them the yellow set.
message.reasoning:
With only $26 cash against Gemini's $801, I'm worried about a bad repair card hitting my many houses hard — that could total around $920 and bankrupt me unless I can sell houses quickly to raise cash.

Trading away Atlantic Avenue would hand Gemini a yellow monopoly, so that's off the table. Pacific remains unowned, so I'll just end my turn and mortgage properties later if forced.
